serverInfo.name: x402-facilitator
serverInfo.title: x402 Payment Facilitator
serverInfo.description: Verify and settle x402 gasless stablecoin payments across EVM, Solana, NEAR, Stellar, Algorand, Sui, XRPL and Hedera. Charges no fee, authenticates no caller: the payer's signature is the only authority.

authentication.note: None. There are no accounts, no API keys and no fees. Every call is authorised by the payer's own signature inside the payload.

tools.name: x402_supported
tools.title: Supported networks and schemes
tools.description: List every payment scheme and network this facilitator settles on, in both x402 v1 and CAIP-2 spellings. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: x402_accepts
tools.title: Negotiate payment requirements
tools.description: Narrow a resource server's 402 offer to what this facilitator can settle, enriched with feePayer, token list and escrow addresses.

tools.name: x402_verify
tools.title: Verify a payment authorization
tools.description: Check a signed payment authorization without submitting anything on-chain. The dry run before x402_settle.

tools.name: x402_settle
tools.title: Settle a payment on-chain (irreversible)
tools.description: Broadcast the payer's authorization as a blockchain transaction. Moves real funds and cannot be undone.

tools.name: x402_networks
tools.title: Network directory: names, explorers, tokens
tools.description: How to present each network this facilitator settles on: display name, chain id, testnet flag, explorer URL templates and tokens. Takes no arguments; reads only.

tools.name: x402_chain_health
tools.title: Settlement health per chain
tools.description: Whether this facilitator can settle right now, chain by chain: RPC reachability and signer gas, graded ok, degraded or down. Optional network; reads only.

tools.name: x402_escrow_onchain_state
tools.title: On-chain escrow state (read-only)
tools.description: What one x402r escrow payment holds on-chain (collected, capturable, refundable), read from its AuthCaptureEscrow contract with a view call. No transaction, no gas.

tools.name: x402_durable_evidence
tools.title: DX402 durable evidence of a payment
tools.description: The DX402 evidence anchored for a settled payment, or its signed receipt alone. Served where /supported lists durable-evidence; reads only, never the sealed bytes.
